subject: Post-signature MAP: implementation epic & canary/training windows
messages:
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@sentinelworks.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 27 Jul 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-signature MAP: implementation epic & canary/training windows

Hi Evan —

Thanks again for signing. Attached is the first draft of the implementation epic we discussed; I embedded the canary, migration and training checkpoints directly into the MAP so your team and ours have a single source of truth. High level asks from our side:

- Confirm any blackout/maintenance windows for the migration week (we've tentatively reserved 10/11 Sep).
- Confirm the primary DB contact for the migration cutover.
- Confirm which user groups should be included in the first canary cohort.

Proposed sequence (summary):
1) Week 0 — Pre-cutover validation: schema checks, smoke tests (ops + infra runbooks).
2) Week 1 — Canary phase: 5% traffic for 48 hours, expand to 25% for 72 hours if no regressions. Automatic rollback trigger on error spike or >2% functional regression.
3) Week 2 — Gradual migration: data sync, final model pin, staged traffic shift.
4) Weeks 3–4 — Training & Handover: two train-the-trainer sessions (30–60m), access handoff and runbook acceptance.

Attachments: MAP_Implementation_Epic_v1.pdf (MAP with milestones), SOW_Signed_SentinelWorks.pdf, runbook-stub.txt (outline).

If that schedule looks good I can move the training invites and lock the canary windows; we can also tighten/loosen the percentages based on your comfort.

Thanks — looking forward to a smooth launch.

— Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0132

From: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@sentinelworks.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: implementation epic & canary/training windows

Jasmine —

Appreciate the clear plan and the attachments. A few quick points from our side:

1) Blackout windows: the week of 8 Sep is reserved for end-of-quarter maintenance across our stack, so we cannot do anything that week. The preferred migration window would be 15–19 Sep.
2) Canary cohorts: for the first group we want internal beta users only (product and ops) — not external customers. That would be approximately 120 users. Is 5% roughly that size for our traffic?
3) Security: our InfoSec team asked whether the MAP can include a checklist for logs/retention and access controls during the canary (they want to confirm nothing is routed to external telemetry).

If you can revise the MAP with the new dates (15–19 Sep migration) and add a short security checklist we can sign off and schedule the training.

Thanks — Evan
Evan Brooks
Director, Platform Engineering | SentinelWorks
evan.brooks@sentinelworks.com
+1 206 555 9981
From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 28 Jul 2025 11:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: implementation epic & canary/training windows

Team — looping in quick ops plan after Evan's notes. Key proposals so we can update the MAP and reply: 

- Move migration window to 15–19 Sep as requested.
- Adjust canary: start at 5% (internal beta ~120 users) for 72 hours rather than 48h to give more signal, then 25% for 48 hours if stable. We will set stricter automatic rollback thresholds: error rate + latency + model-quality regression.
- Security checklist (to add): a short table of required logs (request_id, user_id pseudonymized, model_version), retention policy (30 days for canary telemetry), and a note that no external telemetry exports will be enabled during the canary without explicit sign-off from SentinelWorks InfoSec.
- Owners: Aditya (cutover orchestration), Monica (training lead), Jasmine (customer comms).

If everyone agrees I will update the MAP_Implementation_Epic_v1.pdf and push a new version by EOD.

On Fri we should also confirm the DB contact — Evan, please share a name and a secondary contact.

– Aditya
Aditya Rao
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine.liu@redwood.ai>
To: Evan Brooks <evan.brooks@sentinelworks.com>
Cc: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 Jul 2025 16:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-signature MAP: implementation epic & canary/training windows

Evan — thanks for the quick responses and the date constraints. We updated the MAP per Aditya's notes and attached version 1.1 to this message; highlights below: 

- Migration window moved to 15–19 Sep (reserved).
- Canary cadence revised: 5% internal-only for 72 hours -> 25% for 48 hours -> full ramp if green.
- Security checklist added (logs/retention/access controls) and flagged for your InfoSec review.
- Training: two sessions scheduled (live walkthrough + admin handoff): 10 Sep 14:00–15:00 PT and 12 Sep 09:00–10:00 PT. Monica will send calendar invites once you confirm attendee lists.

Next steps for us:
- Aditya will publish MAP_Implementation_Epic_v1.1 to Confluence and update the runbook-stub.
- Monica will open the training invites and include the train-the-trainer deck.
- Evan, please provide primary DB contact and the InfoSec reviewer name by EOD Thu so we can complete the checklist.

If you reply with a single word ("OK") I will treat that as sign-off for scheduling. If you prefer minor tweaks, please call out line items.

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai

Attachments: MAP_Implementation_Epic_v1.1.pdf, runbook-stub.txt
